description: v2.3.1 (pre-release re-cut #3; replaces the earlier v2.3.1 assets). Extends the Mereframe wrapper sweep to every app.unnamed.rawrecording.b.B* bridge class (17 on 0.8.4), so the per-operation refusal behind 'Couldn't develop · the RAW is safe' (issue #34) is guarded and logged on whichever bridge the develop path routes through: each public wrapper whose body invokes one of its class's native methods gets the same real try/catch, fail-open semantics and per-distinct-rejection fingerprint logging (exception class + message + throwing frame, capped at 12 entries). Carried over: Mereframe 0.8.4 crash fix, array-length-preserving wrapper guards and the Ul.X paywall short-circuit (#34); Reddit comment TreeData constructor-shape discovery so Show deleted posts and comments applies on every 2026.42.0 build (#35); Table Notes (vivekagarwal.playwithdb 20261111) premium unlock (#29); Netflix (Android TV, com.netflix.ninja) patch set ported from ajstrick81/morphe-androidtv-patches (GPL-3.0); Amazon Business compatibility and the screenshot-detection patch from PR #31. Verified by building the Android bundle and the repo's verification scripts against version 2.3.1; on-device runtime verification is still pending.
